draft.title: Entwurf eines Gesetzes für ein steuerliches Investitionssofortprogramm zur Stärkung des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland
draft.relevant_provision: Article 1 number 1, proposed §6(1) number4 EStG, physical/printed page 5; special electric-vehicle depreciation in Article 1 number 2(b), same page.
draft.version_check: The author expressly identifies BT 21/323. No later amendment or enacted version is substituted.
draft.bill_initiator: CDU/CSU and SPD parliamentary groups; Fraktionsgesetzentwurf, not the separately introduced government bill.

card.law_is_about: Tax changes intended to encourage business investment, including preferential treatment of electric business cars.
card.they_want: Oppose the specific preferential treatment of electric business cars.
card.they_claim: The qualifying vehicle-price ceiling rises from €75,000 to €100,000.
card.the_problem: The exact addressed draft raises it from €70,000, so the expansion is €30,000 rather than €25,000.

claim_quote.translation_en: Translation of fragment: from 75,000 to 100,000 euros

counter_quote.original: die Angabe „70 000 Euro“ durch die Angabe „100 000 Euro“ ersetzt.
counter_quote.translation_en: Translation of fragment: the figure 70,000 euros is replaced by the figure 100,000 euros.

correction: The existing qualifying gross-list-price ceiling is €70,000. The explicitly addressed bill raises it to €100,000. The nominal expansion is therefore €30,000, not the €25,000 implied by the submission’s baseline. The separate 75% first-year depreciation rule is a different provision.
effect: The correction makes the price-ceiling expansion larger; it does not undermine the author’s criticism of preferential treatment.
limits: No conclusion about take-up, tax revenue, consumer behaviour or the desirability of the measure. A clerical number slip is plausible; no intent is inferred. The criticism of luxury consumption and other policy premises remain.
materiality_explanation: Minor: the existing threshold is misstated by €5,000, but the proposed €100,000 endpoint is correct and the overall criticism remains. This is separate from its direction.
direction_explanation: False: the wrong higher baseline makes the proposed expansion smaller, cutting against the author’s criticism of extending the preference.
context_checks: Read all 13 submission pages and visually checked pages 5–6.
Checked the exact operative bill and independently located the official DRV archive of pre-submission §6 EStG.
The paragraph separately correctly reports the 75% depreciation rate. That may be a benign explanation for the nearby 75,000 figure but is not evidence of why it occurred.
